forks.title: Ratify the three shapes.
forks.text: ADR 0112 is still Proposed. Everything drawn here assumes Sheet · Panel · Popover; if the founder wants one shape everywhere, this census is the list of what that costs (the sheet exists so the list stays readable; an anchored menu with no anchor has lost its meaning).

forks.title: The studio invite.
forks.text: Reuse the one exception component (Popover modal) with a second opener — my recommendation: one component, however many openers, is still one exception — or collapse the policy to two modal shapes as the ADR's revisit clause says.

forks.title: A delivery without an order.
forks.text: A 640 sheet on /inventory (drawn), or a route under /receipts where the receipts desk already lives.

forks.title: Acts no house surface recreates.
forks.text: Pause AI on a thread · a person-authored one-tap action or quick-action bookmark · an auction purchase · certifications on file · assign a recommendation to a person. One call per act: delete, or build the drawn shape.

forks.title: Where a manual order starts.
forks.text: The owed 'A new order' sheet on /orders, or from a register row, the palette, or Ask AI — OrdersNext has no create path today.

forks.title: Two bells, two user menus.
forks.text: Header.tsx's house branch and HouseHeader's HouseBell/HouseUserMenu both exist. Which survives when the house header lands on every page.
